challengeContent.heroTitle: Knowledge is everywhere. Access is not.
challengeContent.heroDescription: Arabic Braille readers face a real shortage of fast, trusted digital tools.
challengeContent.storyEyebrow: Behind every number is a person
challengeContent.storyTitle: Homework should not take the whole evening
challengeContent.storyDescription: Every evening, Layan and her mother manually transcribe Braille worksheets. Her ability is not the barrier—the missing bridge to her classroom content is.
challengeContent.storyQuote: We want more time for learning, and less time spent transcribing.
